name: hh-meanrev-micro: chop-gated band fade, Bollinger-width compression gate (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM: same ranging-regime band fade, but the regime is read through bb_width (Bollinger band WIDTH) rather than realized vol — a NARROW band is the direct structural signature of a compressed, mechanically-oscillating range where grid/MM bots re-quote around a stable mid. A wide band means the range has already broken and the fade would be knife-catching a trend. Using band width as the gate is economically distinct from vol_realized: it measures the dispersion the maker is quoting AROUND, not the raw return variance, so it captures range-boundness even when a single vol spike would otherwise veto a still-mechanical market. Entry: bb_z below a fitted floor AND bb_width below a fitted compression ceiling. Long-only spot; exit on bb_z reversion. DISCONFIRMER: if the bb_width gate produces the same trades and net Sharpe as the vol_realized gate, the two are collinear here and this is a duplicate — keep one. If the edge only survives when bb_width is at one knife-edge cutoff (flips sign 10-20% either side), it is a fitted artifact — kill.
catalyst: band extreme faded only inside a compressed (narrow-band) mechanical range
